title: OmniPlayer Toolbox
description: An all-in-one in-game menu for full player control: flight options, invulnerability features, and instant access to any item—even in Survival.
body:
OmniPlayer Toolbox is an advanced utility mod designed to give the player full control and convenience through an intuitive graphical interface.

With it, you can manage your inventory, movement, and exploration tools in a single menu.

Features:

Item Catalog: Search for and obtain any item or block (Vanilla or Modded).

Advanced X-Ray: View ores through walls.

Item Management: Quickly enchant, repair, or delete the item in your hand.

Movement: Enable flight and manage teleportation.

Simple and clean interface.

Controls:

Open Menu: Press C.

Use the top tabs to navigate between Items, Movement, Utilities, and Teleport.

The mod must be enabled in the server configuration file.

Compatible with singleplayer and multiplayer.
